Hi Dana / Tom —

Thanks again for the time on Friday — great discussion on the POC scope and performance targets. As promised, attached is a first draft of a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on milestones, owners, and a target close window.

TL;DR (proposed):
- Target close date: 2027-07-15 (flexible pending procurement/legal)
- Key milestones: POC kickoff, performance validation, security review, procurement approval, contract signature
- Primary owners: NovaFin: Dana (business), Tom (procurement); Redwood: Marissa (AE), Jonas (SE)

Please review the attached MAP_NovaFin_v1.xlsx and let me know:
1) Any missing milestones or dependencies on your side (legal/procurement timelines, internal demos)
2) If the proposed target looks achievable or if you want a later date
3) Who on procurement/legal I should loop into the MAP (I put procurement@novafin.com as a placeholder)

Next steps I propose:
- You review and send any edits by EOD Wed (6/9)
- I’ll update the MAP and share v2 with responsibilities and exact dates
- Weekly 15-min checkpoint (Tuesdays) until contract

Attachments: MAP_NovaFin_v1.xlsx (Mutual Action Plan draft)

Thanks — talk soon.

—

- POC kickoff — NovaFin: Dana / Redwood: Jonas — target 2027-06-21 (dependency: POC infra access)
- Performance validation (latency & throughput) — Redwood: Jonas — target 2027-06-30
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence review — NovaFin security + Redwood security — due 2027-07-05 (dependency: Redwood to provide SOC2 report + artifact links)
- Legal redline review (SOW) — NovaFin legal — 7 business days after initial SOW (TBD)
- Procurement approval — NovaFin procurement (Tom) — target 2027-07-12
- Contract signature — both parties — target 2027-07-22

Open dependencies / asks for NovaFin team:
- Confirmation of POC infra timeline (who will provision access?)
- Procurement contact for contract routing (Tom assigned)
- Any additional security artifacts required beyond SOC2 (please list)

I’ll set up a recurring 15-minute checkpoint (Tuesdays at 9am PT) starting 6/22 to keep this moving — if that time doesn’t work, let me know. Attaching MAP_NovaFin_v2.xlsx (updated).

Thanks — looping Vivek for commercial questions and Jonas for the POC kickoff coordination.
